component.name: MediaUrlTask
component.script:
sub init() m.top.functionName = "resolveMediaUrl" end sub
sub resolveMediaUrl() m.top.errorMessage = "" m.top.mediaUrl = "" m.top.streamFormat = "" m.top.mediaTitle = "" m.top.mediaDescription = "" m.top.mediaThumbnail = "" m.top.mediaLength = -1 if m.top.uri = "" m.top.errorMessage = "The channel media resolver URL is missing." return end if
transfer = createObject("roUrlTransfer") transfer.setCertificatesFile("common:/certs/ca-bundle.crt") transfer.initClientCertificates() transfer.setUrl(m.top.uri) port = createObject("roMessagePort") transfer.setMessagePort(port)
if not transfer.asyncGetToString() m.top.errorMessage = "The media URL request could not be started." return end if
timeoutSeconds = m.top.timeoutSeconds if timeoutSeconds <= 0 then timeoutSeconds = 15 event = wait(timeoutSeconds * 1000, port) if event = invalid transfer.asyncCancel() m.top.errorMessage = "The media URL server did not respond within " + timeoutSeconds.toStr() + " seconds." return end if if type(event) <> "roUrlEvent" transfer.asyncCancel() m.top.errorMessage = "The media URL server returned an unexpected network event." return end if
body = event.getString().trim() code = event.getResponseCode()
if code < 200 or code >= 300 m.top.errorMessage = "Media URL resolution failed with HTTP " + code.toStr() + "." return end if
response = ParseJson(body) if type(response) <> "roAssociativeArray" or not response.doesExist("mediaUrl") or not response.doesExist("streamFormat") m.top.errorMessage = "The server returned an invalid media response." return end if mediaUrlType = type(response.mediaUrl) streamFormatType = type(response.streamFormat) if (mediaUrlType <> "roString" and mediaUrlType <> "String") or (streamFormatType <> "roString" and streamFormatType <> "String") m.top.errorMessage = "The server returned an invalid media response." return end if
mediaUrl = response.mediaUrl.trim() streamFormat = response.streamFormat.trim() if mediaUrl = "" m.top.errorMessage = "The server returned an invalid media response." return end if
lowerUrl = LCase(mediaUrl) if lowerUrl.left(7) <> "http://" and lowerUrl.left(8) <> "https://" m.top.errorMessage = "The server returned a media location Roku cannot stream." return end if if streamFormat = "" then streamFormat = mediaFormat(mediaUrl) if response.doesExist("title") titleType = type(response.title) if titleType = "roString" or titleType = "String" m.top.mediaTitle = transfer.unescape(response.title.trim()) end if end if if response.doesExist("description") descriptionType = type(response.description) if descriptionType = "roString" or descriptionType = "String" m.top.mediaDescription = transfer.unescape(response.description.trim()) end if end if thumbnail = randomThumbnail(response) lowerThumbnail = LCase(thumbnail) if lowerThumbnail.left(7) = "http://" or lowerThumbnail.left(8) = "https://" m.top.mediaThumbnail = thumbnail end if if response.doesExist("length") lengthType = type(response.length) if lengthType = "Integer" or lengthType = "LongInteger" or lengthType = "Float" or lengthType = "Double" length = int(response.length) if length >= 0 then m.top.mediaLength = length end if end if m.top.streamFormat = streamFormat m.top.mediaUrl = mediaUrl end sub
function randomThumbnail(response as object) as string candidates = [] keys = [ "thumbs", "thumbnails" ] for each key in keys if response.doesExist(key) and type(response[key]) = "roArray" for each thumbnail in response[key] thumbnailType = type(thumbnail) if (thumbnailType = "roString" or thumbnailType = "String") and thumbnail.trim() <> "" candidates.push(thumbnail.trim()) end if end for else if response.doesExist(key) and (type(response[key]) = "roString" or type(response[key]) = "String") if response[key].trim() <> "" then candidates.push(response[key].trim()) end if end for if candidates.count() = 0 and response.doesExist("thumbnail") thumbnailType = type(response.thumbnail) if thumbnailType = "roString" or thumbnailType = "String" if response.thumbnail.trim() <> "" then candidates.push(response.thumbnail.trim()) end if end if if candidates.count() = 0 then return "" index = 0 if candidates.count() > 1 then index = Rnd(candidates.count()) - 1 return candidates[index] end function
function mediaFormat(url as string) as string cleanUrl = url queryAt = instr(1, cleanUrl, "?") if queryAt > 0 then cleanUrl = cleanUrl.left(queryAt - 1) fragmentAt = instr(1, cleanUrl, "#") if fragmentAt > 0 then cleanUrl = cleanUrl.left(fragmentAt - 1) extension = "" for index = len(cleanUrl) to 1 step -1 character = cleanUrl.mid(index - 1, 1) if character = "." extension = LCase(cleanUrl.mid(index)) exit for end if if character = "/" then exit for end for if extension = "m3u8" then return "hls" if extension = "mpd" then return "dash" if extension = "ism" or extension = "isml" then return "ism" if extension = "m4a" then return "mp4" if extension = "wav" then return "pcm" if extension = "" then return "mp4" return extension end function
